events.speaker: rep
events.text: Thanks for making time today. I saw your team is expanding the enterprise segment.

events.speaker: buyer
events.text: We are trying to ramp new account executives faster without losing consistency.

events.question: Ask how they measure ramp quality today.
events.whyItMatters: The answer can expose whether speed, consistency, or manager visibility matters most.

events.speaker: buyer
events.text: We have Gong, but it mostly helps after the call. During onboarding, reps still need live guidance.

differentiators: Live prompts during the conversation, not only post-call review.
Manager-authored playbooks surfaced by call phase.
Coaching signals tied to rep behavior over time.
commonObjections: We already record and score calls.
Reps do not want another screen during calls.
whatNotToSay: Do not frame Gong as only a recorder.
Do not promise zero workflow change.
events.customerProofQuote: Our managers coach the call while it is happening, not a week later.

events.speaker: buyer
events.text: My concern is whether reps will trust prompts while they are live with a prospect.

events.suggestedResponse: Anchor on configurability and low-interruption prompts, then ask where live help would be useful versus distracting.

events.reason: Buyer is engaged but cautious about rep behavior change.

events.speaker: rep
events.text: I will send a follow-up with examples of low-interruption prompts and rollout paths.
